selection_policy: Only evidence capable of changing or securing a public maturity decision was selected; existing controlled evidence is reused and no duplicate campaign is claimed.

external_campaign.limitation: Existing external evidence is bounded and formulation-specific; no new external case was necessary to change a public maturity decision.

routes.public_claim: Linear static is qualified within the existing element/material/mesh-quality scope.
routes.real_gap: No blocker for the bounded claim; family-specific coverage remains non-transitive.
limitations: Do not infer mixed-mesh, universal element, or arbitrary backend coverage.

routes.public_claim: Modal analysis is bounded by the documented element, mass, solver and evidence combinations.
routes.real_gap: External and family coverage is bounded; static, Newmark and harmonic maturity is not transferred.
limitations: WEDGE6 modal qualification is limited to its declared first-three-mode scope; no general dynamics claim.

routes.public_claim: Linear buckling is bounded for the qualified combinations; HEX8 buckling remains not qualified.
routes.real_gap: HEX8 buckling remains MORE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED and is explicitly excluded from the qualified claim.
limitations: No nonlinear collapse or universal HEX8 buckling accuracy claim.

routes.public_claim: Harmonic response is bounded by the tested analysis and element combinations.
routes.real_gap: External correlation and family breadth remain bounded; no gap changes the current claim.
limitations: Coverage does not imply arbitrary materials, elements or external-solvers equivalence.

routes.public_claim: Newmark dynamics is supported within the documented tested combinations and recovery boundary.
routes.real_gap: Checkpoint recovery is bounded and external dynamics coverage is incomplete; no promotion is justified.
limitations: No universal restart, fault-tolerance, or all-element dynamics claim.

routes.public_claim: Nonlinear static routes are experimental except for the separately bounded small-strain J2 material scope.
routes.real_gap: Finite-kinematic, coupled and broad nonlinear routes lack qualification evidence.
limitations: No transitive promotion from J2, TL, contact or checkpoint evidence.

routes.public_claim: Arc-Length remains an experimental continuation route with bounded evidence.
routes.real_gap: Refined continuation and general nonlinear qualification remain outside the current evidence.
limitations: No general turning-point, coupled, contact or finite-kinematic claim.

routes.public_claim: Small-strain isotropic J2 is qualified within TET4, TET10, HEX8 and HEX20 under the retained route.
routes.real_gap: No decision-changing gap remains; increment sensitivity is characterized without a universal threshold.
limitations: Finite-kinematic J2 remains experimental/not qualified; tangent symmetry is diagnostic only.

routes.public_claim: Frictionless contact is bounded to the documented contact formulations and failure diagnostics.
routes.real_gap: Friction and general contact remain not qualified; no new evidence supports promotion.
limitations: No friction, general mortar, or universal contact convergence claim.

routes.public_claim: WEDGE6 static remains experimental; its separately qualified first-three-mode modal slice is not transferred to static or other routes.
routes.real_gap: Static workflow and external evidence remain bounded; no gap warrants a maturity change here.
limitations: No transitive static/modal/external promotion; no WEDGE15 or mixed-mesh claim.
